name: ftech-office-management
description: Office Management System for Ftech Computers — attendance, work output, salary, leave, tasks, notices and queries across Super Admin / Admin / Employee panels.

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build:deploy: node scripts/fix-prisma-engines.mjs && npm run db:push -w server && npm run db:seed -w server && npm run build -w web
